description: Synthetic, commit-safe evidence packets for measuring quality before synthesis without changing the frozen Agent comparison cases.

cases.challenge: abundant complementary theory, criticism and verified creator speech
cases.focus: How might framing, offscreen space and performance organise constrained intimacy?

passages.title: Synthetic framing handbook
passages.excerpt: Framing organises constrained intimacy by relating figure position, visible boundaries and offscreen space. A close viewing can compare repeated doorway compositions before assigning an effect.

passages.title: Synthetic performance handbook
passages.excerpt: Performance analysis can track posture, gaze, gesture and vocal timing as observable patterns. Their relation to framing may organise proximity without proving a character's interior state.

passages.title: Synthetic sound handbook
passages.excerpt: Offscreen sound can extend a constrained frame by indicating activity beyond visible space. Compare entrances, overlaps and silence before inferring how attention is distributed.

passages.title: Synthetic editing handbook
passages.excerpt: Editing establishes relations among framings and performances through duration, order and repetition. Log comparable transitions to test whether a pattern persists across the work.

reviews.title: Rooms at the edge of speech
reviews.summary: The critic argues that repeated thresholds make intimacy feel negotiated rather than secure, while noting that the interpretation needs confirmation against the film's changing shot scale.
reviews.author: Casey North

reviews.title: Listening beyond the frame
reviews.summary: The reviewer connects withheld voices and room tone to offscreen relationships, presenting this as an interpretation rather than a verified account of every sequence.
reviews.author: Taylor Moss

reviews.title: Gesture and delay
reviews.summary: The essay proposes that delayed gestures and interrupted eye contact complicate the apparent closeness of the central pair, offering a performance-focused question for close viewing.
reviews.author: Robin Vale

critical_claims.critic_claim: The critic interprets repeated thresholds as making intimacy appear negotiated rather than secure.

text_tracks.text: The verified speaker says rehearsal concentrated on pauses and changes of gaze rather than fixed emotional labels.

cases.challenge: sparse film-specific evidence requiring an honest limitation
cases.focus: What can be prepared about editing rhythm before close viewing?

passages.title: Synthetic editing primer
passages.excerpt: Editing rhythm should be tested through observable duration, transition and repetition. Without film-specific evidence, prepare a logging method rather than claiming what the film does.

cases.focus: How might colour and lighting direct attention across repeated interiors?

passages.title: Synthetic colour framework
passages.excerpt: Colour directs attention through relations of hue, saturation, brightness and area. Compare repeated interiors before treating one palette as a stable pattern.

passages.title: Synthetic lighting framework
passages.excerpt: Lighting shapes visibility and contrast across figures and settings. Record source direction and shadow relation to test how attention changes across repeated spaces.

cases.focus: 声音距离如何与空间不确定性发生关系？

passages.title: 合成声音分析手册
passages.excerpt: 声音距离可以通过响度、混响、清晰度与画面空间的关系来检验。应当比较多处段落，再判断空间不确定性是否形成稳定模式。

passages.title: Synthetic sound perspective guide
passages.excerpt: Sound perspective relates apparent distance, reverberation and clarity to pictured space. Compare several passages before inferring a stable pattern of spatial uncertainty.

reviews.title: 听见看不见的空间
reviews.summary: 评论者认为远处的声音与画外空间共同制造不确定性，但明确把这一点作为需要逐场验证的解释，而不是已经测量的事实。
reviews.author: 周宁

cases.challenge: one explicitly selected identity among same-title alternatives
cases.focus: How might eyelines and cutting organise mistrust?

passages.title: Synthetic continuity framework
passages.excerpt: Eyeline relations and cutting can organise access to knowledge and mistrust. Log each exchange before claiming that continuity or disruption forms a repeated pattern.

passages.title: Synthetic narration framework
passages.excerpt: Narration distributes information among characters and viewers. Compare who sees, knows and reacts in each exchange to test competing explanations of mistrust.

reviews.title: Looking across the room
reviews.summary: The review proposes that uncertain eyelines complicate group trust in the 1987 Jordan Pike film, while leaving the exact cutting pattern for close viewing.
